target.title: fix(oauth): redact Anthropic OAuth error response body and URL
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`postJson()` and `refreshAnthropicToken()` in `src/llm/utils/oauth/anthropic.ts`
embedded the URL and raw response body in Error messages on non-2xx responses.
The URL may contain OAuth callback parameters, and the body may contain tokens
or error descriptions — both could surface in logs or error reports.

Follow-up to #102953 which fixed the same pattern in Copilot OAuth.

## Why This Change Was Made

- `postJson()`: replaced raw `body=${responseBody}` and `url=${url}` with
  `extractProviderErrorDetail` for bounded, redacted structured error detail.
- `refreshAnthropicToken()`: removed `url=${TOKEN_URL}` and `details=${formatErrorDetails(error)}`
  from the outer catch; preserved the inner error message via `cause`.

## User Impact

**Before:** `...url=https://platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token; details=Error: Anthropic OAuth request failed with status 400: bad [code=invalid_grant]; stack=...`
**After:** `Anthropic token refresh request failed: Anthropic OAuth request failed with status 400: bad [code=invalid_grant]`

## Evidence

Branch: `fix/anthropic-oauth-error-body` | Base: `upstream/main` | Node: v22.19.0 Linux x64

### Wrapper-level live proof (real HTTP server)

```
Error: Anthropic token refresh request failed: Anthropic OAuth request failed with status 400: ...
URL leaked: PASS
error_description leaked: PASS
```

### Regression tests

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/llm/utils/oauth/anthropic.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  13 passed (13)
```

